question: As of September 2024, who among the following cricketers (men) is India's second highest wicket taker in the Test Matches?
solution:
The correct answer is __**R Ashwin**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of September 2024, **R. Ashwin** is India's second-highest wicket-taker in Test matches.
 
• As of September 2024, the top Indian cricketers with the most wickets in Test matches are:
 
• **Anil Kumble** – 619 wickets
 
• **R. Ashwin** – 474 wickets
 
• **Kapil Dev** – 434 wickets
 
• **Harbhajan Singh** – 417 wickets

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ravichandran Ashwin **is an Indian former international cricketer.**
 
• He is a** right-arm off spin bowler and a lower order batter.**
 
• Widely regarded as one of the most prolific spinners of all time, he represented the Indian cricket team and was part of the Indian team that won the 2011 Cricket World Cup and the 2013 Champions Trophy.
 
• He **plays for Tamil Nadu and South Zone in domestic cricket and for Chennai Super Kings in the Indian Premier League (IPL).**
 
• Ashwin** has taken more than 500 wickets in Tests and was the fastest bowler to reach 300 test wickets in terms of number of innings.**
 
• **He has won eleven Man of the Series awards in Tests, which is the most for any cricketer, along with Muttiah Muralitharan**.
